# MindLeverX

> A generative engine optimization practice in development for mid-market B2B SaaS.

Own the answer.

## Current build

This is a local preview with request intake and a workspace for organizing evidence, drafts and review decisions. Automated audits, engine collection, email delivery and subscriptions are not connected. Numerical exhibits are SAMPLE — NOT MEASURED, except explicitly dated historical file-inspection observations in the case study.

## Intended method

Agree scope, preserve a fixed prompt panel and baseline, review findings, record approval, prepare draft fixes and collect a comparable reading when collection is available. Technical access, content quotability, off-site authority and measured visibility are separate dimensions. Missing dimensions remain unmeasured; a composite requires compatible evidence for all four. API answers are a proxy for the live consumer products.
